description: This file contains the implementation of the BrentSolver class, which provides methods to find zeros of real univariate functions using Brent's method within the Apache Commons Math library.
published: BrentSolver(double relativeAccuracy, double absoluteAccuracy, double functionValueAccuracy)

classes.name: BrentSolver
classes.description: A class implementing Brent's root-finding algorithm with configurable accuracy options, extending AbstractUnivariateSolver.

methods.name: doSolve
methods.description: Performs the root-finding process using Brent's method within the specified interval, considering several initial checks for bracketing and endpoint accuracy.

methods.name: brent
methods.description: Implements Brent's method for zero-finding, iteratively narrowing down the root location using a combination of bisection, linear, and inverse quadratic interpolation.
